name: EPIC 248793941
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 7.8 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,706 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.86 solar masses and 7.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,731 K at its surface.
